name: Turbine Engineer Alan

intro.text: The Pentland Firth has some of the strongest tides in Europe, so we put turbines under the sea in the Inner Sound. Underwater windmills. Tide mills. Battle mills.

win: Generated a lot of energy there.
after: The MeyGen tidal stream array, off Stroma, was one of the first of its kind in the world. Big rotors on the seabed, turning with the tide, twice in, twice out, every day, regular as a clock.
